name: Kolibri 1.1 config.json
notes: Fetched 2026-11-25. model_type kolibri1_1, architectures [Kolibri1_1ForCausalLM] (custom code, needs a fork or --trust-remote-code). 50 layers, hidden 2560, 48 Q / 4 KV heads at head_dim 128, MLA with kv_lora_rank 512 + qk_rope_head_dim 64, 384 routed experts 6 per token plus 1 shared, mlp_only_layers [0,1], sliding_window 513, rope_theta 10000 with NO rope_scaling, max_position_embeddings 262144, FP8 e4m3 block-quant weights (128x128, dynamic activations) with embeddings/lm_head/norms/router kept bf16 (modules_to_not_convert lists every attention proj and every router gate). layer_types: 40 sliding_attention + 10 indexed_attention; kv_source_layers makes six of those layers read another layer's cache (9,14,49 -> 4; 34,39,44 -> 29), leaving 44 distinct caches, 4 of them on indexed layers.
